welcome.tagline: A Nurturing Space for Confident, Curious and Compassionate Learners
welcome.heading: A Loving, Govt. Recognized Foundation for Lifelong Success
welcome.paragraph1: Rising Kids School is a premier, Govt. Recognized & Affiliated early childhood and primary education institution in New Vijay Nagar, Ghaziabad. Established in 2018, we proudly celebrate 8 glorious years of nurturing young minds with value-based education, modern child-centric pedagogy, and individualized care.
welcome.paragraph2: We seamlessly harmonize joyful playway early learning with the National Education Policy (NEP 2020) framework. With official UDISE+ registration, NCERT PRASHAST inclusive screening, and direct national student profile integration (PEN & APAAR), we provide children from Play Group to Class V with a safe, accredited, and future-ready educational home.

deskMessages.heading: Messages from the Desk
deskMessages.subtitle: Inspiring words from the leadership shaping our vision, values, and the bright futures of our rising stars.

founder.title: Message from the Founder
founder.name: Anjali Nair
founder.quote: Education is not merely about preparing a child for school; it is about lighting the lifelong spark of curiosity, character, and compassion.
paragraphs: When we laid the foundation of Rising Kids School in 2018 in New Vijay Nagar, our dream was simple yet profound: to create a joyful, accredited sanctuary where every child receives world-class foundational learning anchored in timeless values.

Over these 8 glorious years, our journey has been defined by the smiles of over 500 children and the enduring trust of our parent community. Achieving formal Government Recognition, integrating UDISE+ standards, aligning with NEP 2020, and adopting national digital frameworks like PRASHAST, PEN, and APAAR are milestones that reflect our relentless commitment to educational integrity.
We welcome every family to become part of our warm school family as we nurture the leaders, thinkers, and compassionate citizens of tomorrow.

branchHead.title: Message from the Branch Head
branchHead.name: Mr. Sumeet
branchHead.quote: Every child enters our gates with a unique spark. Our sacred mission is to turn that spark into a radiant, self-assured flame.
paragraphs: Welcome to Rising Kids School, New Vijay Nagar! As the Branch Head, I witness the magic of childhood unfold every single morning—from the curious eyes of our playgroup toddlers to the confident presentations of our Class V learners.

Our academic framework seamlessly harmonizes playway inquiry, Montessori discovery, and structured foundational literacy and numeracy (FLN). With certified educators, a loving 1:8 early teacher-student ratio, and the PRASHAST inclusive framework, we ensure no child feels rushed or left behind.
We maintain transparent, everyday partnerships with our parents. Together, we build a joyous, secure ecosystem where learning is an adventure and kindness is a daily practice.

signOffs.branchHeadSignOff: In partnership for your child's growth,

educationalTours.title: Educational Tours & Field Visits
educationalTours.lead: Expanding young horizons beyond textbook pages through structured experiential journeys.
educationalTours.desc: At Rising Kids School, learning is never confined to classroom walls. Our carefully planned educational field tours take children to architectural landmarks, planetariums, science museums, botanical gardens, and local craft centers. These journeys connect classroom lessons with real-world wonder, fostering acute observational skills, intellectual curiosity, and cultural pride.

annualDay.title: Annual Day & Cultural Celebration
annualDay.lead: Empowering 100% student stage participation, creative expression, and artistic excellence.
annualDay.desc: The Grand Annual Function is the crowning cultural milestone of our academic year. At Rising Kids School, we champion a strict 100% stage participation policy — ensuring every student from Playgroup to Class V performs before a proud audience of parents and mentors. From vibrant folk rhythms and theatrical value dramas to musical recitals, children shed inhibitions and discover unshakeable confidence.

olympiad.title: National & International Olympiads
olympiad.lead: Cultivating critical thinking, mathematical acumen, and national competitive exposure.
olympiad.desc: Rising Kids School actively prepares and registers primary students for prestigious national and international Olympiad examinations. Through Science (NSO), Mathematics (IMO), English (IEO), Cyber (NCO), and General Knowledge Olympiads, our learners develop sharp analytical faculties, out-of-the-box problem solving, and confidence to compete at higher levels.

csrRallies.title: CSR Rallies & Social Initiatives
csrRallies.lead: "Greener Tomorrow Together" — Nurturing empathetic, eco-conscious global citizens.
csrRallies.desc: At Rising Kids School, moral and character education is given utmost priority. Through our dedicated CSR rallies and community awareness walks, children become champions of social causes. Whether it is sapling plantation, Swachh Bharat cleanliness rallies, anti-plastic drives, or kindness weeks, our students learn that they have the power to create a positive impact on the world around them.
